name: io.github.tonyyang0504/olist_tiny_erp-mcp
description: Olist Tiny ERP (BR integration hub — not a supplier) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_p

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_OLIST_TINY_ERP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of the API v3 app created in your Olist ERP (Tiny) account (Configurações > Aplicativos; https://api-docs.erp.olist.com/).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_OLIST_TINY_ERP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the same app, sent in the token request body.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_OLIST_TINY_ERP_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refresh_token from the one-time authorization-code exchange (https://accounts.tiny.com.br/realms/tiny/protocol/openid-connect/auth ... then /token with grant_type=authorization_code). Access tokens expire after 4 hours and are re-minted from it; the refresh token 'tem duração de 1 dia' and each refresh returns a new one, which replaces it in memory (set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to persist it across restarts).
